content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Little Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific hour requirements based on your degree level, then document your project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify eligibility and identify any gaps before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend synchronous sessions from your office or home, interact with active certified practitioners, and work through real-world scenarios. This formal education satisfies PMI's contact-hour requirement and builds the knowledge foundation for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your education and experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application requirements and deadlines to keep you on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and focused review sessions. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence before you sit for the rigorous PMP assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. Within each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or industry contributions. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure continuous certification and stay current in project management practice.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
